spine: 1. Meerkat 是 Cloudflare Research 打造的全球共識服務，底層演算法是 2023 年發表的 QuePaxa，目標是撐住 330+ 資料中心共用的 control-plane 狀態。
2. QuePaxa 的核心結構差異：leader 依然存在，但只是可選的加速道具——任何 replica 都能推進共識，不像 Raft 把「誰能寫」焊死在單一 leader 身上。
3. 往返成本因此分兩檔：leader 出面提案只要 1 個 round trip（加一次廣播通知），非 leader 提案要 3 個以上（同樣加一次廣播）——leader 只省 round trip 數，不是必要條件。
4. Raft 式協定依賴 timeout 選舉，Cloudflare 稱之為「timeout 的暴政」：跨地域延遲一抖動，timeout 設太短就不斷誤判 leader 失聯、設太長又反應遲鈍，多個 replica 同時競選還會互相干擾，寫入被整批卡住。
5. 容錯模型維持傳統多數決：2f+1 台機器容 f 個故障（crash/網路分區，非惡意行為），只要多數還能互相溝通系統就能繼續前進；概念驗證測到 50 個全球 replica，持續讓 leader 故障，錯誤率也沒有上升。
6. 針對性連線攻擊下，QuePaxa 論文作者量到吞吐量比 Raft、Multi-Paxos 高約 10 倍——因為它不靠 timeout 偵測失聯，攻擊者鎖定 leader 連線打，Raft 陷入選舉風暴，QuePaxa 換道走非 leader 路徑照樣往前。
7. 延遲的本質下限是「多數派 replica 之間的延遲」，Meerkat 用 replica 放置、批次寫入、stale read、把 CAS/交易塞進單輪共識四招去壓低這個下限；現況：仍是實驗性服務、未上生產、短期內只給內部用，最適合寫得少但要求強一致的 control-plane 資料。

perspective.mechanism: Meerkat 把 Paxos 家族的多數決共識重新包裝成一個可以直接掛給 control-plane 用的服務，底層 QuePaxa 演算法拿掉「必須先確定 leader 是誰才能推進」的規則——leader 只是省 round trip 的加速選項，不是繼續運作的先決條件；共識延遲的本質下限是多數派 replica 之間的延遲。
perspective.tradeoff: leader-optional 換到的是抗針對性攻擊、抗跨地域延遲抖動的吞吐量，付出的代價是非 leader 路徑要 3 個以上 round trip、延遲下限仍卡在多數派裡最慢的那個 replica，而且服務目前只是概念驗證、僅供 Cloudflare 內部使用、只適合寫得少的 control-plane 資料。
perspective.reader_use: 工程師在設計跨區域、跨資料中心共享狀態的系統時，可以把「timeout 決定 leader」與「任何 replica 都能提案」兩種設計拿來對照——如果系統的網路延遲會抖動或可能被針對性攻擊，leader-optional 的設計思路比硬調 Raft timeout 更值得考慮。

notes.quote: a consensus service upon which we can build applications that exhibit the above properties (strong consistency and fault tolerance) like a key-value (KV) store.
notes.interpretation: Meerkat 的自我定位：一個全球共識服務，目標是在它之上蓋出強一致又容錯的應用，像 KV store。

notes.quote: a consensus algorithm called QuePaxa, published in 2023 by Tennage & Băsescu et al.
notes.interpretation: QuePaxa 的出處：2023 年由 Tennage 與 Băsescu 等人發表的論文，Meerkat 用它當底層共識演算法。

notes.quote: There is a leader, but it is not required — its only advantage is that it can drive consensus with fewer round trips (one) than other replicas (3+).
notes.interpretation: QuePaxa 的核心結構：leader 存在但非必要，唯一好處是能用更少 round trip 推進共識。原文含 Latin em-dash，prose 引用時只取前半句直接引用，後半句改寫成中文避開站內禁用的半形破折號。

notes.quote: Raft relies on an authoritative leader: the only replica in the cluster that can drive consensus.
notes.interpretation: 拿來對照 QuePaxa 的 Raft 描述：Raft 依賴一個具權威的 leader，是叢集裡唯一能推進共識的 replica。

notes.quote: It takes one if the leader is proposing (+ an extra broadcast to notify replicas of the decision)
notes.interpretation: leader 提案時的 round trip 數：1 次，外加一次廣播通知決議結果。

notes.quote: and three if a non-leader is proposing (+ extra broadcast).
notes.interpretation: 非 leader 提案時的 round trip 數：至少 3 次，同樣外加一次廣播。

notes.quote: proposal decision latency is proportional to the latency between some majority of replicas.
notes.interpretation: 延遲的本質規則：不管走哪條路徑，一次提案決議延遲正比於某個多數派 replica 之間的延遲，這是全文用來解釋為何拿掉 leader 不等於拿掉延遲下限的關鍵句。

notes.quote: f faults in a system of 2f + 1 machines
notes.interpretation: 容錯公式：2f+1 台機器的系統可容忍 f 個故障，Paxos 家族標準的多數決容錯模型。

notes.quote: A majority of the machines in our system are alive and can communicate with one another.
notes.interpretation: 可用性前提：多數機器存活且能互相溝通，系統才能繼續運作。

notes.quote: The authors found that it maintains much higher (~10x) throughput than Raft and Multi-Paxos during such conditions.
notes.interpretation: QuePaxa 論文作者的實測結果：在針對性連線攻擊條件下，QuePaxa 吞吐量比 Raft、Multi-Paxos 高約 10 倍。這是 Cloudflare 轉述論文作者的發現，非 Cloudflare 自己的獨立測試。

notes.quote: networks in which an imaginary adversary can launch targeted attacks on replica connections.
notes.interpretation: n10 吞吐量比較的測試條件：一個假想的敵人能對 replica 之間的連線發動針對性攻擊。

notes.quote: Meerkat is not deployed to production, but we have run multiple proofs-of-concept with up to 50 replicas distributed around the world, to great success.
notes.interpretation: Meerkat 現況：未上生產，但跑過多次概念驗證，最多測到 50 個全球分佈的 replica，官方形容結果良好（「to great success」為定性描述，未附具體量化指標）。

notes.quote: aims to avoid the 'tyranny of timeouts' imposed by protocols like Raft.
notes.interpretation: Cloudflare 對 Raft 類協定弱點的命名——「timeout 的暴政」。Prose 中把這個詞組譯成中文並附英文原詞，不直接複製原文內的引號符號（避開站內半形直引號的排版禁令）。

notes.quote: The problem is that when the timeout is shorter than the network delay between the original leader and that replica, replicas will constantly be timing out and thus blocking writes.
notes.interpretation: timeout 太短的後果：只要短於實際網路延遲，replica 就會不斷誤判 leader 失聯，寫入因此被卡住。

notes.quote: And when the timeout is too long, the system reacts slowly to a failed leader, during which writes are also blocked.
notes.interpretation: timeout 太長的後果：系統對真正故障反應遲鈍，寫入同樣被卡住。與 n14 合起來說明 timeout 這個數字兩邊都難調。

notes.quote: if multiple replicas propose themselves as leader at the same time, their "campaigns" can interfere with each other, causing them to constantly re-propose themselves as leader — all the while blocking writes.
notes.interpretation: 多個 replica 同時競選 leader 時彼此干擾、不斷重新提名、持續卡住寫入。原文含直引號與 Latin em-dash，prose 中改寫成中文敘述並用『競選』翻譯 campaigns，不逐字複製原文標點。

notes.quote: We have seen these exact issues with Cloudflare's systems that use Raft because our wide-area network delays can and do vary wildly, making tuning timeouts especially difficult.
notes.interpretation: Cloudflare 自陳親身遇過這些 timeout 問題——他們自己用 Raft 的系統就因為跨地域延遲抖動大而難以調 timeout。

notes.quote: Many internal services at Cloudflare need to read and modify the same control-plane state from across our 330+ global data centers.
notes.interpretation: Meerkat 要撐住的規模量級：330 多個全球資料中心共用同一份 control-plane 狀態。

notes.quote: developers have control over where their replicas live, they can choose to move replicas closer together, reducing round-trip latency
notes.interpretation: 延遲最佳化手段一：replica 放置——開發者自己決定 replica 位置，挪近可縮短 round trip。

notes.quote: Writes can be batched. So if a replica receives 10 writes in a span of 10ms, it can place all of those in a single proposal, improving throughput.
notes.interpretation: 延遲最佳化手段二：批次寫入——10 毫秒內收到的多筆寫入湊成一次提案，改善吞吐量。

notes.quote: Not all reads must trigger a consensus round. If a developer is OK with reading stale (but never inconsistent) data, they can read from any replica's local data.
notes.interpretation: 延遲最佳化手段三：stale read——能接受讀到舊值（但絕不是不一致的值）就能直接讀任一 replica 的本地資料，不必觸發共識輪。

notes.quote: our key-value store supports compare-and-swap-style writes in which writes execute only if a value has not changed since it was read. (In fact, it supports general transactions.)
notes.interpretation: 延遲最佳化手段四：CAS／交易打包——Meerkat 的 KV store 支援 compare-and-swap 式寫入，且支援更一般的交易，都能塞進同一輪共識。

notes.quote: Meerkat is an experimental consensus service that is still in development.
notes.interpretation: Meerkat 現況定位：實驗性服務，仍在開發中。

notes.quote: it will be kept internal-only for the immediate future.
notes.interpretation: 短期內 Meerkat 只供 Cloudflare 內部使用，不對外開放。

notes.quote: These limitations make it perfect, in the short term, for control plane information that is written infrequently but must remain consistent.
notes.interpretation: 適用場景：寫得不頻繁但必須保持一致的 control-plane 資料。用詞是「perfect」但特別加了「in the short term」限定，屬於帶保留的定性判斷，prose 中不能寫成沒有限定的斷言。

notes.quote: Leaders in our proof-of-concept clusters constantly fail, and the cluster keeps operating with no increase in error-rate.
notes.interpretation: 概念驗證的具體觀察：測試叢集裡 leader 持續故障，叢集照常運作，錯誤率沒有隨故障次數上升。

notes.quote: the system never becomes unavailable or degraded due to a single replica (the leader) being down, unavailable, or degraded.
notes.interpretation: leader-optional 設計的可用性保證：系統不會因為單一 replica（leader）掛掉、失聯或效能下降而變得不可用或降級。

notes.quote: if a non-leader replica hasn't heard from the leader in some amount of time, they propose themselves as the leader. At that point, the old leader has been deposed, and the system cannot accept writes until a new leader has been elected.
notes.interpretation: 傳統 timeout 選舉機制的具體流程：非 leader 逾時未收到消息就自我提名，舊 leader 被廢後，系統要等新 leader 選出才能再接受寫入。

claims.claim_text: Meerkat 是 Cloudflare Research 正在開發的全球共識服務……官方的講法是要在它之上蓋出「像 key-value（KV）store 一樣」的應用
claims.evidence: a consensus service upon which we can build applications that exhibit the above properties (strong consistency and fault tolerance) like a key-value (KV) store.
claims.note: 直接引用與中文轉述皆與原文一致。

claims.claim_text: 撐著 Meerkat 的演算法叫 QuePaxa，2023 年由 Tennage 與 Băsescu 等人發表
claims.evidence: a consensus algorithm called QuePaxa, published in 2023 by Tennage & Băsescu et al.
claims.note: 年份、作者姓名、et al. 均逐字對上。

claims.claim_text: QuePaxa 保留了 leader，但把它從必要條件降級成加速選項，原文寫得更直接：「There is a leader, but it is not required」
claims.evidence: There is a leader, but it is not required — its only advantage is that it can drive consensus with fewer round trips (one) than other replicas (3+).
claims.note: 全文核心論點，直接引用前半句與原文一致；後半句以中文轉述未升級強度。

claims.claim_text: 「Raft relies on an authoritative leader: the only replica in the cluster that can drive consensus.」
claims.evidence: Raft relies on an authoritative leader: the only replica in the cluster that can drive consensus.

claims.claim_text: 「It takes one if the leader is proposing（+ an extra broadcast…）」——1 個 round trip，外加一次廣播
claims.evidence: It takes one if the leader is proposing (+ an extra broadcast to notify replicas of the decision)

claims.claim_text: 「and three if a non-leader is proposing（+ extra broadcast）」——至少 3 個 round trip
claims.evidence: and three if a non-leader is proposing (+ extra broadcast).
claims.note: 原文為「three」；post 寫「至少 3 個 round trip / 3 個以上」，與 n03 的「(3+)」一致，未誇大。

claims.claim_text: 一次提案決議的延遲本質上「proportional to the latency between some majority of replicas」
claims.evidence: proposal decision latency is proportional to the latency between some majority of replicas.
claims.note: 全文延遲下限論述的關鍵句，逐字對上。

claims.claim_text: 套進 2f+1 的公式……2f+1 台機器的系統可以容忍 f 個故障
claims.location: H2「容錯模型」與 leader 可選段的 5-replica 例子
claims.evidence: f faults in a system of 2f + 1 machines
claims.note: post 的 5-replica、f=2、多數派 3 的算術是對 2f+1 公式的正確套用，未逾越來源。

claims.claim_text: 可用性的前提也是同一句老話：「A majority of the machines in our system are alive and can communicate with one another.」
claims.evidence: A majority of the machines in our system are alive and can communicate with one another.

claims.claim_text: 「The authors found that it maintains much higher（~10x）throughput than Raft and Multi-Paxos during such conditions.」
claims.evidence: The authors found that it maintains much higher (~10x) throughput than Raft and Multi-Paxos during such conditions.
claims.note: ~10x 為 QuePaxa 論文作者結果，經 Cloudflare 轉述、非獨立驗證。post 於正文與圖說（line 106, 221）明確標示此為論文作者實驗、Cloudflare 轉述、非自家獨立測試，未把 echo 包裝成多方證實，符合 single-source 誠實揭露要求。

claims.claim_text: 「networks in which an imaginary adversary can launch targeted attacks on replica connections」
claims.evidence: networks in which an imaginary adversary can launch targeted attacks on replica connections.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 用一個詞形容 Raft 這類協定的弱點——「timeout 的暴政」（tyranny of timeouts）
claims.evidence: aims to avoid the "tyranny of timeouts" imposed by protocols like Raft.

claims.claim_text: 設太短：「…replicas will constantly be timing out and thus blocking writes.」設太長：「…the system reacts slowly to a failed leader, during which writes are also blocked.」
claims.evidence: The problem is that when the timeout is shorter than the network delay between the original leader and that replica, replicas will constantly be timing out and thus blocking writes. And when the timeout is too long, the system reacts slowly to a failed leader, during which writes are also blocked.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 說這不是紙上談兵：「We have seen these exact issues with Cloudflare's systems that use Raft…」
claims.evidence: We have seen these exact issues with Cloudflare's systems that use Raft because our wide-area network delays can and do vary wildly, making tuning timeouts especially difficult.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 內部服務要跨的資料中心數字不小：「Many internal services at Cloudflare need to read and modify the same control-plane state from across our 330+ global data centers.」
claims.evidence: Many internal services at Cloudflare need to read and modify the same control-plane state from across our 330+ global data centers.
claims.note: 「330 多個」對應原文「330+」，反覆出現於開篇、圖說與 closer，屬全文骨幹規模量級。

claims.claim_text: 「Meerkat is not deployed to production, but we have run multiple proofs-of-concept with up to 50 replicas distributed around the world, to great success.」
claims.evidence: Meerkat is not deployed to production, but we have run multiple proofs-of-concept with up to 50 replicas distributed around the world, to great success.
claims.note: post 明確標示「to great success」為定性、未附量化指標，未把定性形容誇大成量化成果。timeliness volatile 但來源即為此文，無時效落差。

claims.claim_text: 「Leaders in our proof-of-concept clusters constantly fail, and the cluster keeps operating with no increase in error-rate.」
claims.evidence: Leaders in our proof-of-concept clusters constantly fail, and the cluster keeps operating with no increase in error-rate.

claims.claim_text: 第一招 replica 放置「…reducing round-trip latency」；第二招批次「…10 writes in a span of 10ms…single proposal」；第三招 stale read「…read from any replica's local data」；第四招 CAS「…general transactions」
claims.evidence: Writes can be batched. So if a replica receives 10 writes in a span of 10ms, it can place all of those in a single proposal, improving throughput. ... Not all reads must trigger a consensus round. If a developer is OK with reading stale (but never inconsistent) data, they can read from any replica's local data. ... our key-value store supports compare-and-swap-style writes ... (In fact, it supports general transactions.)
claims.note: 四招引用逐字對上四則來源，數字 10 writes/10ms 一致。

claims.claim_text: 「Meerkat is an experimental consensus service that is still in development.」……「it will be kept internal-only for the immediate future.」
claims.evidence: Meerkat is an experimental consensus service that is still in development. ... it will be kept internal-only for the immediate future.
claims.note: 現況定位句，timeliness volatile，來源即本文，無落差。

claims.claim_text: 「These limitations make it perfect, in the short term, for control plane information that is written infrequently but must remain consistent.」……「perfect」是很滿的斷言，但前面特別加了「in the short term」限定
claims.evidence: These limitations make it perfect, in the short term, for control plane information that is written infrequently but must remain consistent.
claims.note: note 記為 hedged（「in the short term」限定）；post 不僅保留限定詞，還額外拆解說明 Cloudflare 用的是帶保留說法、未承諾擴大或給時間表——比來源更審慎，屬 deflated，非錯誤。

claims.claim_text: 「the system never becomes unavailable or degraded due to a single replica（the leader）being down, unavailable, or degraded.」
claims.evidence: the system never becomes unavailable or degraded due to a single replica (the leader) being down, unavailable, or degraded.

claims.claim_text: 「…if a non-leader replica hasn't heard from the leader in some amount of time, they propose themselves as the leader. At that point, the old leader has been deposed, and the system cannot accept writes until a new leader has been elected.」
claims.evidence: if a non-leader replica hasn't heard from the leader in some amount of time, they propose themselves as the leader. At that point, the old leader has been deposed, and the system cannot accept writes until a new leader has been elected.

claims.claim_text: 比較合理的推測是，不是每個資料中心都需要各自跑一個 replica……但這一點文章沒有明說，只能算是延伸的推測
claims.note: 作者綜合推測，文中以「比較合理的推測是」「只能算是延伸的推測」明確標記為推斷，符合推斷四態的標記要求，無需 fetch。
